trouble_history.symptoms: carbon deposit on spindle seat; sluggish air actuator
trouble_history.presumed_cause: carbon deposit on spindle seat; sluggish air actuator
trouble_history.action_taken: Replaced spindle and guide; lapped seat; renewed air piston seals; tested 7.0 bar actuator
trouble_history.inspection_tips: S/S annual survey — verify valve timing after 50 running hours

trouble_history.symptoms: high exhaust temp on unit 3; dribbling at nozzle tip
trouble_history.presumed_cause: high exhaust temp on unit 3; dribbling at nozzle tip
trouble_history.action_taken: Renewed nozzle holder assembly; pressure test 350 bar; adjusted opening pressure per maker chart
trouble_history.inspection_tips: Record injection pressure in engine log; C/E sign-off before load increase

trouble_history.symptoms: hydraulic oil leak at gland; hunting at 10 deg rudder
trouble_history.presumed_cause: hydraulic oil leak at gland; hunting at 10 deg rudder
trouble_history.action_taken: Replaced ram seals and wipers; flushed system; bled air; rudder angle test ±35 deg
trouble_history.inspection_tips: Class optional attendance — retain oil sample label

trouble_history.symptoms: product water salinity spike; visible weeping between plates
trouble_history.presumed_cause: product water salinity spike; visible weeping between plates
trouble_history.action_taken: Opened end cover; replaced plate gaskets; torque per sequence; salinity <10 ppm at 50% load
trouble_history.inspection_tips: Monitor salinity daily for 7 days post-repair

trouble_history.symptoms: LO outlet temp high; pressure drop increased
trouble_history.presumed_cause: LO outlet temp high; pressure drop increased
trouble_history.action_taken: Pressure test 4.0 bar; renewed plate pack gaskets; chemical clean seawater side
trouble_history.inspection_tips: Compare LO ΔT trend vs baseline in PMS
